title: A Las Vegas federal appeals court rejects Kalshi's emergency bid for an administrative stay against Nevada's efforts to block the platform, a major setback (Krystal Hur/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Krystal Hur / Wall Street Journal: A Las Vegas federal appeals court rejects Kalshi's emergency bid for an administrative stay against Nevada's efforts to block the platform, a major setback — A federal appeals court rejected Kalshi's bid, setting the stage for Nevada's civil-enforcement proceedings
